 Houston Dynamo FC to host official Game 1 Watch Party at Pitch 25, on Tuesday, Nov. 24, facing San Jose Earthquakes in the Round One Best-of-3 Series
 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 HOUSTON (Nov. 18, 2026) – Houston Dynamo FC  will host an official  Game 1 Watch Party  at  Pitch 25  in  EaDo  (2120 Walker St, Houston, TX 77003) on  Tuesday, Nov. 24 , as Houston faces the San Jose Earthquakes in the  Round One Best-of-3 Series  of the  Audi 2026 MLS Cup Playoffs,  powered by  Shell Energy .
 The match is scheduled to kick off at  9:00 p.m. CT , and fans are encouraged to arrive early to show off their Dynamo pride and cheer on the team in orange alongside team legends and fellow La Naranja supporters as Houston makes their  third postseason appearance in four seasons . This is a family-friendly event, and the venue will have full match audio with every screen showing the postseason clash across the indoor and outdoor spaces. Fans can look forward to Dynamo playoff memento giveaways, as well as special appearances from Dynamo legends.
 “Playoff soccer has a special way of bringing Houston together, and we are excited to welcome our community to Pitch 25 for the official Game 1 Watch Party,” said HDFC Chief Marketing Officer  Graham Wincott . “Located in EaDo next to Shell Energy Stadium, Tuesday night’s watch party will provide the perfect setting for supporters, families, partners and fans from across the city to experience the match together and bring the energy, before the Dynamo return home to host Game 2 on Saturday, Nov. 28.”
 Prior to the match from 6:00-8:00 p.m. CT, the Club will host a special  **Cascarita – Own Your Block**  winner-stays-on, pick-up soccer tournament on Pitch 25’s indoor pitch, open to boys and girls ages 12-14 years old. The winning team will receive free playoff tickets to Game 2 back in Houston on Saturday, Nov. 28, and earn their place the compete in the Own Your Block championship at  HDFC Headquarters  prior to Game 2 kicking off at  Shell Energy Stadium . Parents or legal guardians of those interested in participating can register their child’s team ahead of time via Tixr  HERE  or upon arrival at the event.
 Following Game 1, the Dynamo return to  Shell Energy Stadium  on Saturday, Nov. 28, hosting San Jose in Game 2, with kickoff scheduled for 1:30 p.m. CT. Fans can secure their tickets via  Tixr   HERE .
 Houston’s opening round playoff schedule is available below:
 Game 1 – Tuesday, Nov. 24, at 9:00 p.m. CT – San Jose, Calif. – Apple TV, FS1 and FOX Deportes
 Game 2 – Saturday, Nov. 28, at 1:30 p.m. CT – Houston, Texas – Apple TV
 Game 3 (if necessary) – Wednesday, Dec. 2 (time TBC) – San Jose, Calif. – Apple TV
 The Dynamo enter the postseason as the fifth seed in the Western Conference after finishing the regular season with a 14-11-9 (W-L-D) record on 51 points, tied for the fourth-most points in Club history. San Jose enters the postseason as the fourth seed in the Western Conference, posting a 14-10-10 (W-L-D) record on 52 points this season. 
 Houston holds a 19-12-6 (W-L-D) all-time MLS record versus the Earthquakes, outscoring them 57-47 across 37 meetings. Both teams played two tightly contested matches in 2026, the first coming in a  scoreless draw  at Shell Energy Stadium in August, followed by a 1-0 victory for San Jose at PayPal Park in September.
 The Dynamo allowed just 43 goals this season, the fourth-fewest across MLS. Earlier this season, Houston  tied a league record  with a five-match shutout victory streak and  held opponents scoreless  for an impressive 485 minutes, the second-longest run over the last decade for the Dynamo.
 From an individual perspective, attacker  Guilherme  was  named a finalist  for the  2026 Landon Donovan MLS MVP  and  2026 MLS Newcomer of the Year  after establishing himself as a key figure in Houston's frontline. The Brazilian finished the season with 26 goal contributions, having a say on 60.4% of Houston’s scoring plays. Goalkeeper  Jonathan Bond  made his 150 th  MLS appearance on Decision Day and finished top-three in the league with 12 clean sheets this season, tying Tally Hall (2012) and Steve Clark's (2023) single-season Club records.
 The Round One Best-of-3 Series includes the top seven teams from each conference, as well as the two Wild Card Match winners. All 16 teams participating in the Round One Best-of-3 Series earn at least one home game in the series, with the higher seed hosting Game 1 and Game 3 (if necessary), while the lower seed hosts Game 2.
 For the latest news and additional information regarding schedule and tickets, visit  HoustonDynamoFC.com .
